metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins collection

plugins.name: immutable
plugins.description: Append-only SDD toolkit. `/immutable:init` bootstraps a starter (six modes: spec/app/single × ko/en). `/immutable:prd` authors pitches (WHAT). `/immutable:adr` authors Architecture Decision Records (WHY). `/immutable:migrate` upgrades v0.4 repos to the v0.5 profile system (idempotent, zero-data-loss). All authoring skills enforce grill-me interview, adversarial review, and a 90% completeness gate. v0.5 introduces profile-driven section headings + zero-action migration for v2 configs.
